meta.name: istio-traffic-management
meta.description: Configure Istio traffic management including routing, load balancing, circuit breakers, and canary deployments. Use when implementing service mesh traffic policies, progressive delivery, or resilience patterns.

copy.tagline: 配置服务网格流量路由与渐进式发布策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正在用服务网格管理服务间流量,需要安全地滚动发布。
copy.tagline_en: Configure service mesh traffic policies for routing and progressive rollouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage service mesh traffic and need safe progressive delivery.

howto.what: 能按 Istio 规范生成流量管理配置,涉及路由、金丝雀发布、熔断与重试、入口网关等场景,并提供 istioctl 调试命令。
howto.when: 当需要配置服务间路由、金丝雀发布、熔断等 Istio 流量策略,或实施渐进式交付与弹性模式时触发。
howto.what_en: Generates Istio traffic management configurations on demand, covering routing, canary releases, circuit breakers, retries, ingress gateways, and more; also provides istioctl debugging commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to configure service-to-service routing, canary releases, circuit breakers, or other Istio traffic policies, or implement progressive delivery and resilience patterns.

say_en.text: Generate a VirtualService that shifts 10% of traffic to the canary version.
Configure a circuit breaker for ratings: max 100 connections, eject after 5 consecutive 5xx.
say_en.note: Generates a DestinationRule with outlier detection.

say_en.text: Set up an ingress gateway forwarding api.example.com/api/v1 to api-service:8080.
